title: Hotels with an Arc de Triomphe view: which room to book
metaDescription: Three Paris hotels with an Arc de Triomphe view, the exact room category to book at each, and the Champs-Élysées and Eiffel Tower rooms to skip.
h1: Hotels with an Arc de Triomphe view, and which room to book
dek: Three hotels in Paris, around the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Élysées. For each one we list the room category sold with the arch in view, and the rooms named for the Champs-Élysées or the Eiffel Tower.
teaser: Two suites at Fouquet's Paris are named for the arch, and a third hotel's view rests on a travel guide.

decoder.text: Fouquet's Paris sells a suite named for the Champs-Élysées avenue and one named for the arch. Only the second is named for the view; its page describes the view over the Champs-Élysées, the Arc de Triomphe and the Eiffel Tower.

The Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel's rooms page lists Junior Suites without naming the arch. Only the Arc de Triomphe Suite is named for it, and the page says its terrace overlooks the Paris main monuments.
Fouquet's Paris names its Paris Eiffel Suite for the Eiffel Tower. The Harcourt Paris Suite's bedroom has a bull's-eye window that gives the Arc de Triomphe, according to the hotel's page.

faq.q: Which Paris hotels sell rooms with an Arc de Triomphe view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026, Fouquet's Paris sells two categories with the arch in view, and the Renaissance Paris Arc de Triomphe Hotel sells one. Hotel Napoleon Paris is reported by a travel guide to have a terrace view, but no category is sold with it, so ask the hotel.

faq.q: Is the Arc de Triomphe Suite at the Renaissance on a high floor?
faq.a: A 2022 guest review says the Arc de Triomphe Suite with terrace is on the 8th and top floor, with a large balcony that overlooks the arch. The hotel's own page does not give the floor.

faq.q: Is a Champs-Élysées room the same as an Arc de Triomphe room?
faq.a: No. Fouquet's Paris sells a Suite Signature Champs-Élysées, named for the avenue. Its Arc de Triomphe Signature Suite is named for the arch, and its own page describes the view over both.
